title: operad home config
description: The config in $OPERAD_HOME/config.json: the plugins to load, their settings and the store the log uses.

plugins.description: Plugins keyed by name, each with the module to load, whether it is enabled, and its own settings.

module.description: The module or path to import; defaults to the plugin name.

enabled.description: A disabled plugin is not loaded; its stored objects stay.

settings.description: This plugin's section, validated by the plugin's own settings schema.

store.description: Where the fact log lives: a sqlite database file.

path.description: Relative paths resolve against the operad home.

http.description: The HTTP interface serve exposes for clients. It listens on 127.0.0.1 unless a person names other addresses.

enabled.description: Whether serve opens the port. It is on by default, on loopback only; serve creates the token on first use. Set false to turn the interface off.

listen.description: IP literals: loopback, an RFC 1918 or link-local address, or a Tailscale address. Wildcards are refused.

notify.description: A command serve runs when something waits for a person, once per wait. It gets OPERAD_ID, OPERAD_TITLE, OPERAD_REASON and OPERAD_LINK in its environment.

command.description: A shell line run with sh -c in the operad home, for at most 30 seconds. null turns notifications off.

on.description: What triggers the command. Only waiting exists: an object now waits for a person.

mcp.description: What the MCP server may write for a lead. The owner's decisions are not in this list unless it names them.

channel.description: When the MCP channel (operad mcp --claude-channel) sends a block. Takes effect at the next operad mcp start.

notify.description: waiting: a wait opens. ended: the object reaches a final state. loop: the same state is reached loopAfter times with no wait or end between. changes: every state change.

loopAfter.description: How many times an object reaches the same state before a loop block is sent.

actions.description: The plugin actions named <plugin>:<action> that operad mcp may run. Every other action is refused for the owner to run. Takes effect at the next operad mcp start.

confirmActions.description: Allowed actions that also carry confirm: true. An action listed here runs through MCP; one that is only in actions is refused. Takes effect at the next operad mcp start.

ask.description: How a step asks a person with ctx.ask.

graceSecs.description: How long a step waits for an answer, in seconds, unless the call or the step's askGraceSecs param is narrower. 0 does not wait. There is no unlimited value.
